header.function_name: XD08 Order Control Information to NSP Batch

objective: To keep TB_R_H0253_ORDER_CONTROL_PRE in NSP up to date with the crossdock customer order lines of G-System (replicated in DB Surrounding), in one batch (decided 23-Oct; the former XD12 is merged into XD08): the rows changed since the last successful run are inserted (new key) or updated.
ORDER_STATUS keeps the value of the first replication; a later change in G-System is written to UPD_STATUS: '6' received / allocated, '2' cancelled. Lines with UPD_STATUS are not taken by XD09.
Every run releases all drafts of TB_R_INSTRUCTION (Create ASN done, Submit not done): the cases come back in the delivery plan of XD10.
A cancel of qty already in a submitted ASN is not changed by the batch: it is listed in Change Order Number (XD11) for the D/S team.

nodes.label: Insert new keys / update existing keys, UPD_STATUS

steps: The scheduler starts the batch (daily, after G-System has provided the data). Write LOG1.

steps.text: Read the rows of TB_R_H0253_ORDER_CONTROL_PRE (DB Surrounding) with INTF_UPDATE_DT > watermark (crossdock lines, ORDER_STATUS '7', '6' or '2').
children: New crossdock lines, changed qty, split serials (partial cancel / receipt) and status changes.

steps.text: Upsert into TB_R_H0253_ORDER_CONTROL_PRE (NSP) per unique key (incl. SERIAL_NO):
children: New key: insert all source columns; HOLD_FLAG = 'N', PO_MAPPED_FLAG = 'N'; UPD_STATUS = NULL when the source status is '7', else the source status.
Existing key: update the source columns except ORDER_STATUS (first value kept); UPD_STATUS = source ORDER_STATUS when it is '6' or '2'; HOLD_FLAG / PO_MAPPED_FLAG not changed.

steps.text: Release all drafts of TB_R_INSTRUCTION (rows with ASN_NO NULL), whatever changed:
children: Delete the rows; MAPPED_QTY of TB_R_PRA_DAILY_ORDER_MAPPED - their qty; PO_MAPPED_FLAG = 'N' on their lines.
The cases come back in the delivery plan of XD10; the supplier ticks them again and creates the ASN again (lines with UPD_STATUS are no longer taken).

steps.text: Check the lines with UPD_STATUS '2' that have rows in TB_R_INSTRUCTION with ASN_NO (cancel of qty in a submitted ASN):
children: Write LOG5 per line and ASN; the line is listed in Change Order Number (XD11). Nothing is changed in the ASN.
Cancelled qty not a multiple of pcs/case: LOG6 (abnormality).

steps: No error: commit, save the new watermark (max INTF_UPDATE_DT taken) in the Log, LOG2. Error: roll back, watermark not changed, LOG3. Exit.

items: One batch for H0253 (decided 23-Oct): the former XD08 (status 7 / 6) and XD12 (status 2) are merged; the old XD11 cancel batch is replaced by the screen Change Order Number (XD11).

The source table is insert / update: a crossdock line starts with status 7 and can change to 6 (received / allocated) or 2 (cancel). A partial cancel or receipt splits the line into a new SERIAL_NO (scenario files skenario_h0253.xlsx, simulasi_asn.xlsx).
UPD_STATUS: NULL = status 7 (no change); '6' = received / allocated in G-System; '2' = cancelled in G-System. ORDER_STATUS of NSP keeps the first value.

Example (simulasi_asn.xlsx): 15-Oct CO-14101 / CO-14102 inserted (UPD_STATUS NULL); 16-Oct CO-14101 → UPD_STATUS 6 (received), CO-14102 → UPD_STATUS 2 (cancelled while on hold, no ASN: nothing else to do); 18-Oct CO-14104 → UPD_STATUS 2 although in ASN00003 → listed in XD11; CO-14105 → UPD_STATUS 6 (candidate for the replacement).

Drafts: every run deletes all TB_R_INSTRUCTION rows with ASN_NO NULL (Create ASN not submitted), gives the mapped qty back and sets PO_MAPPED_FLAG 'N'; rows with ASN_NO are never deleted. [Submit ASN] of XD10 re-checks the draft too.
Only changed rows are read (INTF_UPDATE_DT > watermark); upsert and draft release run in one transaction; the watermark is saved only when the run succeeds.
Read by XD09 (lines with UPD_STATUS NULL, not mapped, not on hold), XD10 and XD11. Table structure: see Appendix.

tables.name: TB_R_H0253_ORDER_CONTROL_PRE
tables.description: Order control data, pre-order picking info (I/F H02-53, DVJO950) replicated from DB Surrounding by XD08. Structure from the G-System I/F layout; physical names follow the existing table. Key (PK) = unique key of the I/F layout. Rows with UPD_STATUS 6 / 2 are kept for tracking (retention optional, TBC). UPD_STATUS is a new NSP column (proposed).
columns: No.7 Serial No., Card No. Part of the key; distinguishes split records of the same order line. Added to the source table by the DB Surrounding team (decided 19-Oct).
No.8 TOPAS Order Type: '1': VOR, '2': E/O, '3': S/O, 'F': F/O
No.12 Original Shipping Qty or Estimated Shipping Qty

No.14 Order Status: '1': Pending '2': Reject/Cancel '3': B/O '4': Firm Order '5': Vender Direct '6': Allocation '7': Cross Dock In NSP: value of the first replication (normally '7'); a later change is written to UPD_STATUS
No.15 B/O Instruction Code: '1': B/O Cancel, '9': Follow-up
No.18 Direct Delivery Code: Blank: Not vendor direct delivery '1': Vendor direct delivery
No.19 Direct Delivery Flag: '0': Not direct delivery, '1': Direct delivery
No.25 Special Price Code: '1': Special price, Blank: Not applicable
No.29 B/O History Code: '0': Default, '1': B/O
No.33 Order Portion Code: '1': Reject '2': Alteration '3': Process '4': Amendment
No.35 Shipping Process Control Code: Blank: No change '1': Higher priority to B/O
No.36 Procurement Process Control Code: '1': Skip substitution check '2': Skip large order division (including skipping irregular order check) '3': '2' + skip order taking check '4
No.38 Created Demand Flag: '0': Not created demand, '1': Created demand
No.39 Special Customer Flag: '0': Regular, '1': Special
No.40 POSS Transmission Judgment Flag: '0': Out of target, '1': Transmission target
NSP column: hold by the D/S team in ASN Cross Dock Creation (XD10) ('Y' / 'N'); 'N' on insert, never changed by XD08
NSP column: 'Y' when the whole line is in TB_R_INSTRUCTION ([Create ASN] XD10, Change Order Number XD11); 'N' on insert; set back to 'N' by XD08 when a draft of the line is released

NSP column: status change in G-System after the first replication: NULL = no change (status 7) / '6' = received or allocated (source ORDER_STATUS 6) / '2' = cancelled (source ORDER_STATUS 2). Set by XD08; lines with UPD_STATUS are not taken by XD09

tables.name: TB_R_INSTRUCTION
tables.description: Real mapping made by [Create ASN]: one row per supplier case x customer order line x PO of the chosen blocks (case and line sequence of XD09). Rows are deleted by [Back] / [Cancel] on the Case List; [Submit ASN] (5.7) fills ASN_NO and CASE_NO. Columns proposed. Rows without ASN_NO are a draft: every run of XD08 releases all drafts (decided 23-Oct); a cancelled line in a submitted ASN is moved to other lines in Change Order Number (XD11).
columns: Supplier code (one ASN = one Supplier Code + Plant)
Case sequence of the Create ASN (Case 1, 2, ...)
Order line x PO within the case
Customer Order Date of the case
Qty of the line mapped to the PO in this case
Manifest number of the Pra Daily Order
Rit of the Search (route master, existing)
Route of the Rit (route master, existing)
Draft of one [Create ASN] (all rows of the creation); NULL after [Submit ASN] is not needed (ASN_NO filled). Every run of XD08 deletes the rows with ASN_NO NULL
ASN number; NULL until the ASN is submitted (5.7)
Case number; NULL until submitted (auto generated with the existing last sequence)
User who last changed the record
